content.value: Calculate real power and reactive power employing complex forms. The voltage of a circuit (12) is $\nu = 2 0 0 \sin ( \omega t + 3 0 ^ { \circ } )$ and the current is $i = 5 0 \sin ( \omega t + 6 0 ^ { \circ } )$ . What are the power factor, reactive factor and volt-amp?
